openapi_document:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Inventory Lookup API
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /inventory/{sku}:
    get:
      parameters:
        - name: sku
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Inventory item returned
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required:
                  - sku
                  - available
                properties:
                  sku:
                    type: string
                  available:
                    type: boolean
